title: A Mysterious Manouvre
summary: Prepare the pawn race so promotion comes with check, and retreat when advancing the king blocks it.

nodes.question: How can White avoid a drawn simultaneous promotion?
nodes.explanation: White has Ke7 and h2 against Ka2, g7 and h7. The first pawn move is h4 in the saved board, correcting the narration’s initial h5.

exercises.prompt: Why does the king’s square matter during a pawn race?
exercises.answer: After Kf8, Qg8 checks Ka2 along g8–a2. After Kf7, White’s own king blocks that diagonal, giving Black time to promote.
